content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCHRC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HBCHRC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for CSSD Technician and 1 for Radiation Technologist.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: CSSD Technician: H. Sc (Science) with 50% minimum marks and two years of experience in C.S.S.D. of a hospital is preferred. Radiation Technologist: B.sc (Physics) with a minimum of 55% marks and a Post Graduate Diploma in Radiotherapy OR B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) from a recognized Institute/university/approved by AERB. One year of post-qualification internship/experience in a modern radiation department using Linear Accelerators is required.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: CSSD Technician: Up to 30 years Radiation Technologist: Up to 35 years Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HBCHRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should report at the specified time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for CSSD Technician and Radiation Technologist posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by HBCHRC. One vacancy is for the CSSD Technician post and the other is for the Radiation Technologist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the CSSD Technician position?
faq.answer: For the CSSD Technician role, candidates must have completed H. Sc (Science) with a minimum of 50% marks and possess two years of experience in CSSD of a hospital, which is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Radiation Technologist post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Radiation Technologist position, candidates need a B.Sc. (Physics) with at least 55% marks and a Post Graduate Diploma in Radiotherapy, or a B.Sc. (Radiotherapy Technology) with one year of internship/experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the CSSD Technician post is up to 30 years, and for the Radiation Technologist post, it is up to 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the CSSD Technician is Rs. 23,870/- per month, and for the Radiation Technologist, it is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the HBCHRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include an MCQ test if there are many applicants, followed by an interview. The final selection will be based on performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.
